text:
lina: hey team — first day! quick checklist: 1) Figma org invite not showing (SSO seems stuck) 2) access to the Product/Research roadmap Notion doc? 3) how do I get added to the research participant pool and scheduling calendar? also curious about prototype naming convention so i don't create a mess
kevin: welcome! pinged eng-sso to bump the invite. can you DM me the email you signed up with so i can escalate? :wave:
lina: lina@redwood.ai
design-ops-bot: Welcome Lina! To speed up SSO access please try: `open https://auth.redwood.com/sso` then click "Sign in with SSO". If that fails, file an IT ticket with `/ticket create "SSO access block"` and include your email — ops will triage.
emmie: added you to the Figma org manually, you should have an invite in your inbox (check spam). also invited you to #design-research.
lina: i can open Figma now but i still see "Request access" on the folder Roadmaps / 2026 — any owner who can grant view/edit?
jordan: i own that folder — gave you view + comment. if you need edit perms what's your github handle? we map edit rights to GH for audit reasons.
lina: @jordan it's lina-g. edit would be helpful — planning to drop sprint-0 notes straight into the roadmap file.
kevin: for research participants we keep a canonical pool in Notion -> Research Ops -> Participant Pool. here: https://notion.so/redwood/research-pool. scheduling invites and the calendar are managed from #research-scheduling — i'll add you now.
lina: perfect — thanks. also small thing: what's our prototype naming convention? i've seen `proto/V1` and `p_v1` floating around.
emmie: prefer `proto/<feature>-v1` (kebab-case) — we'll add the short rule to the design handbook. example snippet:
```
proto/
  onboarding-v1
  billing-usability-v2
```
kevin: tiny follow-up: if you plan to run any moderated sessions this week ping @research-ops a day ahead so they can provision study links and compensation.
design-ops-bot: New hire checklist updated: Figma, Notion, Research channel, calendar access. If any access issues persist, DM @design-ops.
lina: all cleared — can see the roadmap, joined channels, and opening prototypes. huge thanks everyone :tada:
